The main takeaway from our work is that

the direct pattern mining approach is promising for mining discriminative patterns in large data sets, and the branch-and-bound strategy is a powerful tool to tackle the efficiency challenge in pattern mining.
, for the problem of mining frequent patterns for classification, it is not necessary to mine all patterns first, then select the best ones, and finally apply them for classification.
